limitations.note: The rewrite stopped idle cycles from advancing the state, but replaced the original three-valid-byte packing sequence with disjoint pairs, dropping the output that combines the second byte’s low nibble with the third byte.
The test expected no output on the third accepted byte, so it validated the rewrite’s pairing assumption instead of checking for the required second packed word, 12'hd12.
